title: Signed evaluation for ordinary module Hom complexes
statement: Let R be any commutative ring and let c,V be unbounded cochain complexes of R-modules. For the ordinary module Hom complex [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex] and the usual signed direct-sum total tensor there exists a chain map e:c tensor Hom_R(c,V) to V. On the tensor summand c^p tensor Hom_R(c,V)^j its value on x tensor h is (-1)^(p*j) h_p(x). This holds in all integer degrees with no boundedness, flatness or injectivity hypotheses.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J7: Hom complexes and ordinary internal Hom

proof.text: Use the degree-p component of a module Hom cochain as a bilinear evaluation map, multiplied by (-1)^(pj). The tensor and direct-sum universal properties assemble these component maps into maps of each total degree.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J7: Hom complexes and ordinary internal Hom

proof.text: Precompose the proposed chain identity with each tensor summand and check on pure tensors. Expand the tensor differential d_c tensor 1 plus (-1)^p times 1 tensor d_Hom and the Hom differential. The two h(d_c x) terms have opposite coefficients because (-1)^p(-1)^(p(j+1))=(-1)^(pj) and (-1)^((p+1)j)=(-1)^(pj)(-1)^j. The remaining term is d_V of the proposed evaluation. Tensor and coproduct extensionality give a chain map with the stated formula.

theorem module_hom_signed_evaluation :
    ∃ e : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor c (moduleHomComplex c V) (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) ⟶ V,
      ∀ (p j : ℤ) (x : c.X p) (h : (moduleHomComplex c V).X j),
        (e.f (p + j)).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor c (moduleHomComplex c V) (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ)
            p j (p + j) rfl).hom (x ⊗ₜ[R] h)) =
          (p * j).negOnePow • (h.v p (p + j) rfl).hom x
